answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46050 Country: India Title: Books regarding salah Question: I would like to know some authentic book giving complete details about prayers in journey whether in bus or train and when to pray qasr. Answer ID: 46050 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 998/780/B=1434) Please read the following books: (1) Namaz Ki Kitab. (2) Kitabul Masail. (3) Ilmul Fiqh. (4) Bahishti Zewar. (5) Fatawa Darul Uloom, Salatul Musafir Chapter (6) Fatawa Mahmoodiya etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
